completedWork: src/config.js now parses RS_PLAN_RATE_LIMIT, RS_PLAN_RATE_WINDOW_MIN, RS_GENERAL_RATE_LIMIT (1-100000, default 300) and RS_GENERAL_RATE_WINDOW_SEC (1-3600, default 60) into planRateLimit, planRateWindowMin, generalRateLimit, generalRateWindowSec, refusing out-of-range values by variable name; all four are in .env.example with their defaults. New src/auth/general-limit.js counts every non-public, authenticated call in rate_events (kind general, key u:<id>) inside one db.tx (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) together with the delete of expired rows, refuses the call over the limit with 429 RATE_LIMITED {limit: general} and Retry-After, and does not insert a refused call; createAccess calls it right after authentication (anonymous 401 and the signature webhook route are not counted); createAuth builds it from config. src/auth/client-ip.js gained throttleKey(): IPv6 becomes its /64 (2001:db8:1:1::/64), IPv4 and ::ffff: mapped addresses (dotted or hex form) collapse to IPv4; clientIp uses it for the socket address and the trusted last X-Forwarded-For hop. confirmRequirements in src/services/requests.js returns the latest version without inserting a requirements row, audit row or re-plan when the values and the derived field provenance equal the latest version (still HTTP 201, intake_status kept at confirmed). Tests: limits.test.js (TR-C-2 x2, SEC-C-3 config), client-ip.test.js (SEC-C-2 x2), general-limit.test.js (SEC-C-3 limiter, one-transaction check, access hook), rate-limits.test.js (301st call, p95, plan key separation both ways, public routes uncounted, configurable), auth.test.js (SEC-C-2 sign-in 6th gets 429, register /64), requests-plans.test.js (SEC-C-3 unchanged confirm), env-example.test.js (four new defaults). Failing state first: ev:ev-mv2zhs1c-019dd6ab (18 failures). Three existing assertions had to follow the new behaviour: two in test/api/requests-plans.test.js counted every kind-general rate_events row (now they count only plan:% rows, since every signed-in call now adds a u:<id> row) and one asserted u:<id> was 0 (now asserts > 0 and distinct from the planning key); three in client-ip.test.js / auth.test.js expected a full IPv6 address as key (now the /64).
remainingIssues: The general limit counts every authenticated call including a 403 role refusal and a CSRF-token failure of a signed-in user; only anonymous calls (401), public routes and the signature-authenticated webhook route are outside the per-user count. The webhook route keeps its own 60 per IP per minute limit, which a later payment task owns.

Every authenticated request now writes one rate_events row (at most 300 per user per minute, expired rows deleted on the next call of that user). Rows of users who stop calling stay until their next call; the admin reset in src/services/admin.js deletes only request_create and plan:% rows, and no retention sweep of old u:<id> rows exists.

A confirm is treated as unchanged only when the derived fields JSON (values plus provenance and wording) equals the latest version, not just the columns; a confirm that changes only provenance because a newer extraction exists still writes a new version.
RS_GENERAL_RATE_LIMIT and RS_GENERAL_RATE_WINDOW_SEC are not in the spec's Deployment table; their names, bounds (1-100000, 1-3600) and defaults (300, 60) are this rework's choice per the assignment.
